dedupe_keys.name: continuous sewer hydraulic and pollutant concentration observations from 2008 to 2011 including precipitation data laboratory analysis and a hydrodynamic model

description: Graz University of Technology and partners publish hydraulic and pollutant observations from the Graz-West R05 combined-sewer catchment in Austria for 2008–2011. Flow, depth, velocity, COD, suspended solids and temperature measurements at one- or three-minute intervals are paired with laboratory samples and three rainfall gauges. Standardised CSV files include instrumentation, units, gaps and calibration metadata. Zenodo also supplies a hydrodynamic SWMM catchment model with dry-weather calibration, freely under CC BY 4.0. The site-specific package can calibrate sewer-flow and pollutant-transport simulations. Sensor conversions and gaps affect interpretation, while dry-weather calibration does not establish performance for every storm. The accompanying catchment model uses the catalogued model-epa-swmm engine.
